name: CS-1
_comment: Instrument: twochannels' CS-1 (a CS-80-style synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1), its own code in cs1/ (cs1_engine.c, one copy per instance). vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is cs1_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh.
